extDesc.message: Press Ctrl+V on any site: rich-text editors are left alone; plain text fields get the screenshot uploaded through a hidden same-origin imgchr page in the background, with the link inserted automatically. Optional timed deletion. No imgchr tab needed.

tosSummary.message:
The red lines in the imgchr.com Terms of Service most relevant to casual screenshots:
· Images containing QR codes are prohibited
· Cartoons / manga / ACG / anime & game imagery is prohibited
· Unauthorized movie or TV screenshots and covers are prohibited
· Upload limit: 60 images/hour; 5 MB per image for logged-in users
· The free tier is for personal, non-commercial use only
Violations lead to deletion of all images under the account plus account and IP bans. Make sure you understand this before continuing.

optKeepHint.message: No API key and no imgchr tab needed. Cross-site uploads are performed by a hidden imgchr page in the extension background (created on demand, destroyed when idle); auth_token and login cookies never leave imgchr's own pages.

optAskKeepLabel.message: Ask me before each upload how long to keep the image

optExpirationHint.message: Uses the image host's own expiration field when possible (the server deletes on schedule); which retention values are available depends on the imgchr page for your account. If a duration isn't supported, the extension falls back to its own pending-deletion queue and performs the deletion via the hidden channel when due.

optAutoInsertLabel.message: Insert the link into the focused input field automatically (off = copy to clipboard only)

optFormatHint.message: Whichever you pick, the result card keeps one-click copy buttons for every format; in plain text fields you can still click "Switch to ![](…)" afterwards.

optRateHintSuffix.message: / 60 — a hard cap from the imgchr.com Terms of Service; the extension refuses to send requests once it is reached.

optRed3.message: Unauthorized movie or TV screenshots and covers are prohibited

optRed4.message: Pornographic, violent, extremist, infringing or illegal content is prohibited

optRed5.message: Free tier is for personal, non-commercial use only; 5 MB per image for logged-in users

optTosHint.message: Violations lead to deletion of all images under the account plus account and IP bans. Casual screenshots can easily hit the QR-code and anime/game rules — use your own judgment.

optResetTos.message: Reset; ask me again next time

optNoInterfereHint.message: The paste listener is registered before any page script (capture phase) but only observes — it never intercepts, so the page's own paste logic runs untouched. It fully stays out of the way when the caret is in a rich-text (contenteditable) editor, which can accept images itself, or when the page takes over the paste (preventDefault). In all other cases — a plain input/textarea, or the caret outside any input — it uploads. Copying text never triggers it.

offscreenJustification.message: Loads an imgchr.com page in a hidden iframe so it can issue the same-origin upload/delete requests itself (the site offers no API for free accounts).
